 Summary
 Man Utd 2-1 down at home to Roma through Soule strike and Malen penalty
 Fernandes scores retaken penalty to give hosts hope in second half
 Fans protest inside Old Trafford by throwing balls on to pitch - read more 
 Lamine Yamal and Raphinha (2) put Barcelona 3-0 up against Aston Villa
 Watch Final Score at top of page, including commentary from the Nou Camp
 Live Reporting
 Jess Anderson, Gary Rose & Sam Drury
 Most recent Most popular CLOSE! published at 21:27 GMT 21:27 GMT 
 Man Utd 1-2 Roma 
 The tide has turned massively here.
 Diogo Dalot sees his shot cleared off the line and Roma are massively under the cosh here.
 A third corner for United and Bryan Cristante is asking for more from his side.
 19 15 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Delightful ball by Cancelo' published at 21:27 GMT 21:27 GMT 
 Barcelona 3-0 Aston Villa 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on BBC Radio 5 Live at Nou Camp 
 John McGinn gets beaten too easily by Joao Cancelo but what Cancelo does is brilliant. It's a delightful ball with the inside of his right foot. It's beautifully placed into Raphinha and that should be that.
 63 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:26 GMT 21:26 GMT 
 Barcelona 3-0 Aston Villa 
 Nick Mashiter 
BBC Sport football news reporter at the Nou Camp 
 Devastating and with just so much class. First Cancelo's skill and cross and then Raphinha's sharp finish. That was just too good for Aston Villa. 
 57 41 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:26 GMT 21:26 GMT 
 Man Utd 1-2 Roma 
 Delivered to the back stick by Bruno Fernandes and Harry Maguire wins the tussle with Marten de Roon to nod his header wide. It takes a slight deflection and United have another corner. 
 132 97 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:25 GMT 21:25 GMT 
 Man Utd 1-2 Roma 
 A nice ball into the box and Bryan Mbeumo is reaching but can't get there and instead it's poked behind for Manchester United's first corner of the match.
 230 139 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Barcelona 3-0 Aston Villa published at 21:25 GMT 21:25 GMT 
 Raphinha (64 mins) 
 Lovely goal!
 João Cancelo gets away from John McGinn on the left and races towards the box. He spots Raphinha making a run and plays a lovely outside of the boot pass behind the defence and the forward drives in first time.
 465 393 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:23 GMT 21:23 GMT 
 Barcelona 2-0 Aston Villa 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on BBC Radio 5 Live at Nou Camp 
 Since going 2-0 down, like when they went behind in the first half, Aston Villa's response has been positive.
 247 82 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:23 GMT 21:23 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Two very generous decisions have got Man Utd back into this.
 Keith 
 989 474 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 21:23 GMT 21:23 GMT 
 Barcelona 2-0 Aston Villa 
 Aston Villa make a triple change as João Gomes, Johan Manzambi and Emiliano Buendía go off, Ibrahim Mbaye, Leon Goretzka and Ross Barkley come on.
 121 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:23 GMT 21:23 GMT 
 Man Utd 1-2 Roma 
 Roma enjoying a spell of possession and they just need to take a breath here.
 To be honest, they should be three or four ahead but the mood has shifted inside Old Trafford and it's Manchester United posing the danger.
 234 154 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:22 GMT 21:22 GMT 
 Barcelona 2-0 Aston Villa 
 John McGinn tries to play a low free-kick into the Barcelona box but ends up giving it straight to Lamine Yamal and the hosts have the chance to break, but Zion Suzuki is alert to the danger and the attack breaks down.
 110 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'No mistake this time' published at 21:21 GMT 21:21 GMT 
 Manchester United 0-2 Roma 
 Alan Shearer 
Former England striker on Amazon Prime 
 A different technique this time. Choosing power into the roof of the net, even if the keeper goes the right way I don't think he's saving this one. No mistake this time.
 348 383 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:20 GMT 21:20 GMT 
 Man Utd 1-2 Roma 
 Well Roma have been passive in this second half and they are paying the price.
 Old Trafford is rocking as Manchester United try to get back on level terms.
 482 539 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Karl gives Bayern the lead at Atletico published at 21:19 GMT 21:19 GMT 
 Atletico Madrid 0-1 Bayern Munich; Feyenoord 0-3 Inter 
 Image source, Getty Images Lennart Karl has opened the scoring for Bayern Munich at Atletico Madrid .
 The 18-year-old catches defender Robin Le Normand in possession inside the Atletico box and dinks it over Jan Oblak.
 A bit of a gift for Bayern but a lovely finish from the teenager.
 In Rotterdam, Inter have extended their lead over Feyenoord thanks to a thumping strike from Piotr Zielinski.
 The midfielder lets fly from 25 yards and his left-foot shot whistles past the goalkeeper.
 151 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HITS THE WOODWORK published at 21:19 GMT 21:19 GMT 
 Man Utd 1-2 Roma 
 Oh my word!
 Manchester United swarm forward and Bryan Mbeumo slams off both sides of the woodwork.
 First one post then the other.
 Should be 2-2. You can not take your eyes off this.
 627 526 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Man Utd 1-2 Roma published at 21:18 GMT 21:18 GMT 
 Bruno Fernandes (58 mins, pen) 
 Bruno Fernandes goes the same way but instead of the bottom corner he blasts it high into the net.
 Brilliant penalty and Manchester United are back in it.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 1751 3488 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY published at 21:17 GMT 21:17 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-2 Roma 
 A second bite of the cherry for Bruno Fernandes!
 638 1985 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:17 GMT 21:17 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-2 Roma 
 Hang on, is there encroachment here?
 Bruno Fernandes could get a reprieve here as Bryan Cristante was encroaching.
 465 1565 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 MISSED PENALTY published at 21:16 GMT 21:16 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-2 Roma 
 Bruno Fernandes' penalty is saved!
 What did I say about when it rains it pours? Wow. You could not script this.
 Devis Vasquez gets down to his right to made a super save from Fernandes' low penalty.
 Image source, Reuters 
 3258 825 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:15 GMT 21:15 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-2 Roma 
 VAR has had a look at the penalty.
 There wasn't a lot in it to be honest but it was unlikely it would be overturned.
